description: Apply the capability-versioning ADR (chief/54) into the specs: encode the subscriber-compatibility decision at KCB §7.2 (capability-bus.md ~line 254), set the concrete removal date for the deprecated application/vnd.koine.edl+json media type at KMI §4.4 (media-interchange.md ~line 253, which currently has no removal date), and note the KFT §11.5 inheritance (a finetuned model pins its kft_version). Normative edits, so per koine's draft->candidate->ratified convention the touched specs bump version and return to candidate pending the mutate-live-schema pressure test (chief/56). ROADMAP.md Phase F2. Agnostic: bind roles, no deployment names.
verify: python3 -c "import json,glob; [json.load(open(f)) for f in glob.glob('schemas/*.json')]; print('schemas ok')"

userStories.title: KCB §7.2 — encode the versioning decision
userStories.description: Promote KCB §7 open question 2 into a normative clause implementing the ADR's subscriber-compatibility contract (semver-on-names vs content-addressed-schemas, per the ADR's decision).
acceptanceCriteria: capability-bus.md §7.2 (or the appropriate normative §) states the versioning/subscriber-compatibility rule the ADR (chief/54) decided, referencing the ADR, and is consistent with the KCB §2 AgentCard-extension manifest and the capability cost + grant-spend model (§2.1/§5).
The KCB version header is bumped and Status set to candidate, with a changelog entry citing the ADR.
The clause names chief/56-live-schema-mutation-scenario as the pressure test that must break-test it before re-ratification.

userStories.title: KMI §4.4 — set the edl+json removal date; note the KFT §11.5 inheritance
userStories.description: Apply the deprecation half: give the deprecated application/vnd.koine.edl+json media type a concrete removal version at KMI §4.4 under the ADR's deprecation policy, and note in KFT §11.5 that the capability-versioning decision is the one it inherits.
acceptanceCriteria: media-interchange.md §4.4 gives application/vnd.koine.edl+json a concrete removal version consistent with the ADR's deprecation-window policy (it currently states removal 'no earlier than the next minor version' with no date); the KMI version header is bumped and Status set to candidate with a changelog entry.

fine-tuning.md §11.5's inheritance note is updated to point at the resolved ADR/§7.2 decision (a finetuned model pins its kft_version), as an informative reference; whether KFT's version bumps depends on whether its normative surface changed — keep it informative-only if unchanged.
The three edited specs read consistently and all cite the one ADR (chief/54); schemas/*.json still parse.
